'''Old Crater''', created by {{player|ParboiL|flag=ru|link=Parboil}} in [[2002]], is a small lava trap map.  The idea of the design of this map belongs to {{player|AmoK|flag=au|}}. 

It is recommended to be played using deathmatch mode 4/5, and its many pillars of varying heights make it very suitable for aim practise. The only item on the map is a [[RA]] on the middle platform.
